description: This file contains implementation of rational number support functions such as gcd reduction, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, and root extraction for rational numbers, including exception handling for division by zero and indefinite forms.

methods.name: gcdrat
methods.description: Reduces a rational number by dividing numerator and denominator by their GCD.

methods.name: fracrat
methods.description: Converts a rational to its fractional form, simplifying if necessary.

methods.name: mulrat
methods.description: Multiplies a rational number by another rational.

methods.name: divrat
methods.description: Divides a rational number by another rational, with exception handling for division by zero.

methods.name: rootrat
methods.description: Calculates the root of a rational number.

methods.name: zerrat
methods.description: Checks if a rational number is zero.
